title: Safai Saathi change manifest
description: The machine-readable list of every change to the contract. Each entry pairs with a CHG-nnn-*.md file in this folder. The two change together, never one alone.

changes.title: Freeze the collection and field contract
changes.author: platform-owner

changes.title: Move the raw driver phone to staffPhones and mask it at the source
changes.author: platform-owner

steps: Copy drivers.phone into drivers.phoneMasked using the PHONE_MASK_FORMAT 98XXXXXX10
Move the raw value into staffPhones/{code}
Update the admin panel to read drivers.phoneMasked and staffPhones.phone
Update the driver app to read drivers.phoneMasked
Deploy the new rules LAST. The old rules keep the old clients working until then

changes.title: Scope the Firestore rules by custom claims instead of by signed-in
changes.author: platform-owner

steps: Deploy the bindDeviceToVan callable so the driver app gets a vanId and a driverId claim
Deploy the bootstrapUserSession callable so the user app gets a deviceId and a routeId claim
Deploy the mintStaffToken callable so the admin panel gets role, staffId and wardIds claims
Ship the client halves that sign in with the custom token
Deploy the new rules LAST. Until then the old loose rules keep the old clients working

changes.title: Route every admin panel write through a callable
changes.author: platform-owner

steps: Deploy the five callables: setComplaintStatus, publishNotice, upsertDriver, upsertStaff, setVanDepot
Update the admin panel to call them instead of writing directly
Deploy the rules that deny every admin write

changes.title: Shard the GPS trail into a trail subcollection
changes.author: platform-owner

steps: Add the trail subcollection write to the driver app's tracking engine
Chunk at 1000 points per document
Read the trail by concatenating the chunks in index order
Stop writing trips.gpsTrail

changes.title: Delete verifyDriverPin, setDriverPin and the vanSecrets collection
changes.author: platform-owner

steps: Confirm the office does not call verifyDriverPin
Delete the verifyDriverPin and setDriverPin functions
Delete the DEMO_SEED_BYPASS path inside setDriverPin
Delete the cloud_functions dependency from pubspec.yaml
Verify with: grep -rn 'verifyDriverPin|setDriverPin|vanSecrets|DEMO_SEED_BYPASS' lib/ functions/src/ scripts/. Zero hits

changes.title: Set the arrival alert radius to 100 m from the ward boundary
changes.author: platform-owner

steps: The constant lives in 02-contracts/constants.json. Change it there, not in the code

x-rules.together: Every entry pairs with its explainedIn file. They change in the same commit.
x-rules.severity: S0 emergency, S1 breaking, S2 new capability, S3 additive, S4 internal. See 02-contracts/severity-policy.md.
x-rules.priority: P0 to P4. Severity plus impact.
x-rules.migrationRequired: An S1 or S2 entry without migration.steps cannot merge.
x-rules.collectionNaming: affectedCollections names the Firestore collection, plural, so a developer can grep for it. A subcollection is named by its schema file's base name, singular, because its Firestore path is not a top-level collection. Both forms resolve, because 08-tools/check-consistency.ts maps the plural to the singular schema.
